data_fields.name: roll_budget_ms
data_fields.donor_constant: 250 / (|delta| + 1) per step, three waits per step

best_idea: Show a changed number as a short roll through the colour bands it crosses, so the colour changes on the exact step where the value crosses the threshold rather than at the end of the change.
decision_why: Keep the stepped roll and the band change at the crossing step; drop the sprite digits and the busy wait; use a fixed total budget per change; clamp the displayed value before computing the delay; replace the Error fallback with a dev-visible warning.
acceptance: On a 100-max character, a hit that takes HP from 60 to 20 shows yellow from 49 down and red from 24 down, and the roll finishes inside the 400 ms budget (budget in data, 400 ms proposed), with no frame over 50 ms during the roll at 375 px wide.
